title: Leaderboard: remove Score column and restore Win % + Streak (all-time)

requirements.summary: Remove the Score stat from the All-Time Rankings leaderboard table UI (header and row values) and eliminate any user-facing "Score" text on the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard table no longer contains a column labeled "Score".
No score value is rendered in any leaderboard row.
No user-facing text references "Score" on the Leaderboard page.

file_operations.description: Update the All-Time Rankings <Table> to remove the Score <TableHead> and the per-row Score <TableCell>. Remove the score calculation usage from rendering and ensure no remaining user-facing "Score" text exists on the page.
Delete the now-unused score helper (e.g., calculateScore) and any related imports/logic so the Score stat is not computed or displayed anywhere in the leaderboard table UI.

requirements.summary: Restore the Win % column in the all-time leaderboard table, computed from all-time wins and totalGames with safe zero-games handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Win % is computed from the existing all-time stats returned by the backend (wins and totalGames) and does not depend on weekly/monthly timeframes.
When totalGames is 0, Win % displays as 0% (or equivalent non-error value) and the UI does not crash.

file_operations.description: Add a "Win %" column to the All-Time Rankings table and compute it per row from stats.wins and stats.totalGames (all-time). Implement safe formatting to display 0% when totalGames is 0, and ensure bigint-to-number conversion does not crash the UI.

requirements.summary: Restore the Streak column in the all-time leaderboard table using the all-time streak value provided by the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Streak values displayed are sourced from the backend leaderboard stats (all-time) and update appropriately after recording/removing wins/losses.
The leaderboard page renders successfully for users with no games recorded (streak shown as 0 or equivalent).

file_operations.description: Add a "Streak" column to the All-Time Rankings table and render the per-user streak directly from stats.streak (all-time), defaulting to 0 (or equivalent) when needed to avoid crashes for users with no games.
